title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Amplify Tagmented Amplicons
author: Opentrons
materials: Pick up 200 uL tips from slot 4
Dispense into trash and discard tips.
Aspirate 40 uL of AMP Master Mix

steps.title: Engage Magnetic Module
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module on the deck.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant from Magnetic Plate
steps.instruction: Using a fresh 200 µL tip from slot 4, aspirate 120 µL from column 1 (A1) of the magnetic plate located in slot 3, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 200 µL tip from slot 4.
Aspirate 120 µL from column 1 (A1) of the magnetic plate on slot 3.
Discard the tip into the trash.

steps.title: Add Wash Buffer to Magnetic Plate
steps.instruction: With a new 200 µL tip from slot 4, aspirate 40 µL of AMP Master Mix, dispense 40 µL of Wash Buffer into column 1 (A1) of the magnetic plate in slot 3, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 200 µL tip from slot 4.
Aspirate 40 µL of AMP Master Mix.
Dispense 40 µL of Wash Buffer into column 1 (A1) of the magnetic plate on slot 3.
Discard the tip into the trash.
